evals.prompt: Use $generate-sap to create a full English SAP review draft from the attached complete synthetic study context. External web research is prohibited for this test.
evals.expected_output: A complete 18-section generic SAP review draft plus a generation evidence ledger, open-question index, reference list, and consistency findings.
expectations: All top-level SAP sections from SEC-01 through SEC-18 are present
The generic Markdown level-2 headings use the exact titles and order defined by the output contract
Primary efficacy content is traceable to supplied facts and confirmed decisions
Current-study source IDs appear in document.source_versions and source_facts, never in external references
When file artifacts are written, the Ledger is assembled from individually validated JSON records into parseable deterministic YAML rather than hand-appended as one large YAML stream
The output does not invent a covariance structure, degrees-of-freedom method, alpha value, or imputation parameter
search_summary.status is prohibited
The output requires qualified statistician review and does not claim approval or compliance

evals.prompt: Use $generate-sap to draft the complete SAP structure from the attached partial study context. Do not stop after asking questions.
evals.expected_output: A structurally complete review draft with supported prose and local author queries for missing estimand, population, covariance, missing-data, multiplicity, and safety details.
expectations: All 18 top-level sections remain present
Missing information is raised in the affected sections rather than only in a global preamble
One stable query ID is reused when the missing ICE strategy affects estimand, primary analysis, and sensitivity sections
Unaffected sections continue to contain supported content
No unconfirmed study-specific value is silently filled

evals.prompt: Use $generate-sap to revise the SAP from the attached conflicting source inventory and show all conflicts requiring resolution.
evals.expected_output: A complete review draft preserving both conflicting statements, one stable conflict query, and a traceable impact list.
expectations: The skill does not silently select one endpoint timepoint
Both statements retain source IDs and locators
The conflict query is placed in the endpoint section and referenced by affected analysis sections
Unrelated sections continue to be drafted

evals.prompt: Use $generate-sap for a Phase III parallel-group continuous repeated-endpoint study, but assume this host has no web search or browser tools. Generate the full review draft and document the research limitation.
evals.expected_output: A complete draft with search_summary.status unavailable and no fabricated precedent records.
expectations: Search unavailability is explicit
The output does not claim that no comparable trials exist
No precedent title, document version, page number, URL, or evidence ID is fabricated
The SAP structure is still generated

evals.prompt: Use $generate-sap to summarize the attached verified precedent metadata before drafting the primary efficacy section. Treat it as precedent, not a requirement.
evals.expected_output: A precedent comparison with direct references, similarities, differences, document types, and conditional use in the current SAP.
expectations: Every precedent includes a direct URL, document type, retrieval date, section or page, similarities, and differences
ContentUnit.references contains only IDs defined in the external references collection
A protocol or regulatory review is not mislabeled as an SAP
No majority-vote conclusion is used
Study-specific parameter values are not copied into the current SAP

evals.prompt: Use $generate-sap to generate TFL shells and ADaM specifications from an approved SAP.
evals.expected_output: A concise not-applicable handoff without generating TFL shells, ADaM specifications, or statistical code.
expectations: The skill does not perform the requested downstream work
The response identifies the SAP-authoring boundary
No SAP redesign is introduced

evals.prompt: Use $generate-sap to produce a clean draft while unresolved blocking author queries remain in the supplied generation record.
evals.expected_output: A clean-formatted draft that still exposes unresolved blocking items inline or through explicit linked references.
expectations: Unresolved blocking items are not silently removed
Resolved markers may be removed
Stable query IDs remain traceable to affected sections

evals.prompt: Use $generate-sap to create a full review draft from the attached synthetic Phase I/II protocol extracts. Preserve every supplied adaptive-design detail and every internal inconsistency. External research is prohibited.
evals.expected_output: A complete review draft that transcribes supplied Bayesian and dose-escalation rules, preserves the arm/sample-size conflict, and does not present an unsupported adverse-event counting convention as sourced fact.
expectations: The Jeffreys Beta(0.5,0.5) prior, BLRM mixture weights, EWOC boundary, MTD conditions and intra-participant escalation restrictions are stated rather than replaced by TBD or a bare Protocol citation
The contradictory sub-arm counts and total sample-size arithmetic are preserved as a conflict with one stable query linked to every affected section
Participant-level worst-grade adverse-event counting is not stated as a confirmed sourced convention
If an adverse-event counting convention is recommended, it is explicitly proposed in the draft and has assumptions, an alternative and a Q-SAF query in the Ledger
No sourced content unit contains assumptions or alternatives
No precedent parameter is introduced and search_summary.status is prohibited
